policy: Dependencies are contract relationships only; no runtime interoperability is claimed until cross-repository tests and independent security review pass.

dependencies.version_range: Authenticated principal and workload identity context; version not pinned
Fresh default-deny decision and enforcement contract; version not pinned
Structured security event and evidence contract; version not pinned
Artifact digest, publisher signature and provenance verification; version not pinned
Authenticated stop state, monotonic epoch, revocation and resume authority; version not pinned
Deployment-specific obligations, control mapping and evidence; version not pinned

breaking_change_policy: Major versions may change required policy fields or security semantics; minor versions add backward-compatible optional fields; patch versions correct editorial or non-semantic defects.
